items.question: What does this Gemini watermark remover remove?
items.answer: It is intended for the visible Gemini image mark. It does not remove invisible SynthID or C2PA provenance signals.

items.question: How do I remove Gemini watermark from image files?
items.answer: Upload one supported image, sign in with Google, start processing, inspect the marked corner, and download only if the result meets your needs.

items.question: Can Gemini itself hide the visible watermark?
items.answer: Some current accounts may show a Media watermark setting in Gemini or Flow. Check the available settings first; availability may vary by product, account, region, and legal requirements.

items.question: Is the Gemini watermark remover free to use?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini is free to use. Google sign-in is required before processing. Confirm there is no route-specific credit limit before publishing this answer.

items.question: Which image formats are supported?
items.answer: The shared WatermarkGemini uploader supports one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB. Reconfirm these limits on this exact page before launch.

items.question: Do I need to sign in?
items.answer: Yes. The shared WatermarkGemini flow requires Google sign-in to start processing, so this page should not promise no-login or no-sign-up use.

items.question: Does this remove SynthID or other invisible watermarks?
items.answer: No. This page only targets a visible image mark and does not claim to remove SynthID, C2PA, or other provenance signals.

items.question: Can I remove a Gemini watermark from video?
items.answer: Not on this image page. Video and Veo watermark removal require a separate workflow and separate product verification.

items.question: Will the result be lossless or perfect?
items.answer: No quality guarantee should be made before real output tests. Inspect the marked corner and surrounding texture before downloading.

items.question: Is it okay to remove a Gemini watermark?
items.answer: Only edit content you own or have permission to modify. Follow Gemini’s terms, local law, platform rules, and any AI-disclosure obligations. Do not remove marks to misrepresent authorship.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini affiliated with Google?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Gemini is a trademark of its respective owner.
